title: Fixed-size stabilization and numerator relations for a localized conormal basis
statement: Let R and A be commutative rings and A a finitely presented R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let P₀ be a polynomial presentation of A with n₀ variables and m₀ relations [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and put B = A_a for a ∈ A [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. If (B ⊗_A Cotangent(P₀)) × B^r is B-linearly isomorphic to B^q, then there are m ≥ q and a presentation P of A on exactly n₀+r variables with m relations such that the localized conormal classes of its first q relations are a B-basis indexed by Fin q. No smoothness or bound q ≤ n₀+r is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Tag 07EZ, proof of part (e), stabilization paragraph

proof.text: Apply Algebra.exists_zero_variable_presentation_localized_cotangent_equiv to obtain a presentation on exactly n₀+r variables and m₀+r relations with localized conormal module isomorphic to (B tensor Cotangent(P₀)) × B^r. Compose with the assumed stable trivialization and transport Pi.basisFun B (Fin q) through the inverse equivalence.

The tensor localization map f(x)=1 tensor x has IsLocalizedModule structure by Mathlib IsLocalization.tensorProduct_isLocalizedModule. Apply IsLocalizedModule.surj to every basis vector to obtain a numerator x_j and denominator s_j in powers(a) with s_j times the vector=f(x_j). Lift x_j to a kernel element g_j using Extension.Cotangent.mk_surjective. IsLocalization.map_units makes each denominator a unit of B. Module.Basis.unitsSMul rescales by these units, giving exactly the numerator classes as basis vectors. This argument allows q=0 and a zero localization.

Prepend the q kernel numerators to the m₀+r relations of the stabilized presentation using Sum.elim and finSumFinEquiv. Ideal.span_le proves that the full list is contained in the kernel; Ideal.span_mono and the original relation-span equality give the converse inclusion. Build a Presentation with the identical toGenerators and this relation list, so its conormal module is definitionally unchanged. Set m=q+(m₀+r), use Nat.le_add_right for q≤m, and simplify finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd to identify each first relation with its numerator.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07EZ, proof (e), stabilization and numerator relations; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07EZ read 2026-10-13. Lean proof uses the Mathlib composed-conormal exact sequence, denominator surjectivity, unit basis rescaling, and explicit relation concatenation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stabilized_presentation_localized_conormal_basis
    (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [FinitePresentation R A] (a : A)
    {n₀ m₀ : ℕ} (P₀ : Presentation R A (Fin n₀) (Fin m₀)) (r q : ℕ)
    (hstable : Nonempty
      (((Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P₀.toExtension.Cotangent) ×
        (Fin r → Localization.Away a)) ≃ₗ[Localization.Away a]
        (Fin q → Localization.Away a))) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (P : Presentation R A (Fin (n₀ + r)) (Fin m)) (hc : q ≤ m)
      (b : Module.Basis (Fin q) (Localization.Away a)
        (Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P.toExtension.Cotangent)),
      ∀ j : Fin q, b j = 1 ⊗ₜ[A]
        (Extension.Cotangent.mk (P := P.toExtension)
          ⟨P.relation (Fin.castLE hc j),
            P.relation_mem_ker _⟩)
